class_guess: Structural counter + chaotic edge: drifting defect groups (hierarchical counter) fed by a chaotic right edge
summary: Defect groups drift left at 1, 3/4, 1/2, 3/8.. cells/bounce: exact 16-bounce counter on left, chaotic edge on right
mechanism: Tape: (01)^n runs split by single defects (11, 00, 1111); the head zig-zags between them; the wall grows 2 cells/bounce.
Defect groups drift left from the right edge at exact speeds 1, 3/4, 1/2, 3/8...; left block repeats every 16 bounces.
The right edge is chaotic (hi ~ 20·sqrt(L)). Halting needs E to sweep an odd (10) run ending in 00: unseen to 1e11.

rules.name: G16 left block (16 bounces)
rules.cases: a odd >= 1, b even >= 4, c even >= 2, independent; r = real right part (4 tapes, 1e7..1e9). Other parity classes: 0/12 pass (wrong guess killed). [Notation fixed at assembly: was '<D 011 ...', which puts an extra 0 left of the 11; re-checked 30/30 in sim notation.]

rules.name: orbit lock
rules.to: G16 skeleton with (a,b,c,d) = (8n+61, 2n, 2n-2, n), L = 32n+26, at every 16th wall visit
rules.cases: observed on the orbit (25 snapshots, n = 25..1051), not a random-parameter test

rules.name: right sweep, odd
rules.cases: also E> 10^(2n+1) -> 01^(2n+1) F> in 4n+2 (F then reads the next cell: 0 0 1 there = halt)

rules.name: edge extension
rules.cases: the only place B is entered in 1e9 steps (512 times); B always reads 0 there

template.diff: 8 of 11 transitions differ under best relabeling (A0 A1 B0 C1 D0 E0 E1 F1); BLv3 TM2 8, BLv2 TM1-3 8-9, Bouncer_v4 9
template.note: Method carries: columns (01)^n+defect, head passes as a signal stream, per-column transducer + quadRect closure. Lemmas don't: we add 1111 columns, our edge grows, and BLv3's own cut tape halts on our machine at sim step 20,175.

strategy:
BLv3-style. 1) es/ind for sweep/wall/edge rules; 2) the 16-bounce left-block rule with a odd, b,c even (multistep_nonhalt + progress_nonhalt_cond on n);
3) the hard part: a closed (regular) set for the edge region that excludes 'E> 10^odd 001' (LongN/InfiniteRect quadRect, or a CTL-style language search first).
risks: Edge is chaotic and growing (hi ~ 20*sqrt(L), 56 groups at 1e9): a finite closed set may not exist -> STUCK at step 3.
Halting is a parity event (odd (10) run before a 00 defect); a late halt like BLv2's 3 kills is possible. None to 1e11.
On mxdys's UBRRBA_TODO list (Dennis: fair game); twin #27 is this exact table started in state E, so one proof should cover both.
